problem:
Consider the equation in the variable $v,$ given by

$$
(k-2)v-3=5
$$

where $k$ is a constant. Given that this equation has no solution, what is the value of $k?$

$k=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
Suppose we have an equation of the form

$$
ax=b
$$

where $a$ and $b$ are constants, and $b\ne 0.$ If $a=0,$ then the equation has no solution.

First, let's write our equation in the form $av=b:$

$$
\begin{aligned}(k-2)v-3 & =5 \\ (k-2)v-3+3 & =5+3 \\ {{(k-2)}_{⏟}}_{a}v & ={{8}_{⏟}}_{b}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the equation has no solution if

$$
k-2=0.
$$

Solving this for $k,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}k-2 & =0 \\ k & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
